## Background

This run set tests the effect of the network's `SFAC_BASE` speed-factor
attribute — a per-link multiplier applied to free-flow speed on specific
corridors — by comparing a baseline run (`sfac-base`) against a run with
those factors removed (`sfac-removed`, `SpdFactor: SFAC_REMV`). To measure
the effect, a dedicated set of screenlines was built covering every corridor
that carries a nonzero `SFAC_BASE` value, plus a parallel/diversion-route
screenline nearby for each one, so volume shifts onto alternate routes show
up alongside the change on the corridor itself.

These screenlines are not part of the TDM's own regional cordon set
(`CVM_Screenlines_V10b.shp`, shown below in gray for context) — they're a
purpose-built addition (`sfac-screenlines.shp`) layered on top of a copy of
that file, applied for this run set only via the `Screenline_shp` Control
Center override.

```{python}
#| label: load-screenlines
import geopandas as gpd
import json

gdf = gpd.read_file(SHP_PATH).to_crs(4326)
facility = gdf[gdf["Type"] == "Facility"]
parallel = gdf[gdf["Type"] == "Parallel"]
original = gdf[gdf["Type"] == "Original"]

facility_json = facility[["ID2", "Label", "geometry"]].to_json()
parallel_json = parallel[["ID2", "Label", "ParallelOf", "geometry"]].to_json()
original_json = original[["ID2", "geometry"]].to_json()
```

## Map

Click a line for its label. Red lines are screenlines on the SFAC-affected
corridors themselves; blue lines are the paired parallel/diversion facility.
Long corridors (US-89, Legacy Parkway and its HOV lane, SR-193, Redwood
Road, Bangerter Highway) have several screenlines spaced every 3-4 miles
along their length rather than just one.

```{python}
#| label: render-map
#| output: asis
html = f"""
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.css" />
<div id="sfac-map" style="height:650px; border-radius:6px; overflow:hidden;"></div>
<script src="https://unpkg.com/leaflet@1.9.4/dist/leaflet.js"></script>
<script>
(function() {{
  const facility = {facility_json};
  const parallel = {parallel_json};
  const original = {original_json};

  const map = L.map('sfac-map').setView([40.85, -111.95], 10);
  L.tileLayer('https://{{s}}.basemaps.cartocdn.com/light_all/{{z}}/{{x}}/{{y}}{{r}}.png', {{
    attribution: '&copy; OpenStreetMap, &copy; CARTO', maxZoom: 19
  }}).addTo(map);

  L.geoJSON(original, {{style: {{color: '#999', weight: 2, dashArray: '4,4'}},
    onEachFeature: (f, layer) => layer.bindTooltip('Regional cordon screenline ' + f.properties.ID2)
  }}).addTo(map);

  L.geoJSON(parallel, {{style: {{color: '#1A8FAA', weight: 4}},
    onEachFeature: (f, layer) => layer.bindPopup('<b>Parallel facility</b><br>' + f.properties.Label)
  }}).addTo(map);

  L.geoJSON(facility, {{style: {{color: '#c0392b', weight: 4}},
    onEachFeature: (f, layer) => layer.bindPopup('<b>SFAC facility</b><br>' + f.properties.Label)
  }}).addTo(map);
}})();
</script>
"""
print(html)
```
